formula.tex: \term{llr}{\Lambda} = c \ln\frac{c}{\term{expected}{e}} + (\term{totalCases}{C} - c)\ln\frac{C - c}{C - e}, \quad e = \term{windowWeight}{W}\,\frac{C}{\term{totalWeight}{B}}, \quad p = \frac{1 + \term{exceeding}{\#\{s : \Lambda_s^{\max} \ge \Lambda\}}}{P + 1}
formula.ascii: Poisson model, high rates: for a window with c observed cases and baseline weight W, e = W C / B, LLR = c ln(c / e) + (C - c) ln((C - c) / (C - e)) when c > e, else 0. The cluster is the window with the largest LLR. p = (1 + #{replicates s with maximum LLR_s >= LLR}) / (P + 1): one-sided, the maximum over all windows already accounts for the search, ties count as exceedances.
